_doc: Difficulty levels (GDD section 16.4), chosen in the leader creator when a career starts and kept in the save (old saves: normal). One table scales the campaign: start_cash (the starting capital), income (the government's yearly budget, contract and briefing rewards, race prizes), expectation (the points the press expects of a project, MissionProject.expected_points) and rival_speed (the rivals' monthly attempt chance, RaceDirector; the GDD appendix C: x0.8 on the easy level, x1.2 on the hard one); bankrupt_line is X of the bankruptcy line -X in era-1 credits (Bankruptcy, economy.json bankruptcy). Read by src/tycoon/tycoon_difficulty.gd. Texts: name_key and desc_key in i18n/tycoon_leader_strings.csv.
